list.title: Projects

list.searchPlaceholder: Search projects: code, name or description
list.emptyAdminHint: Get started by creating your first project.
list.emptyMemberHint: Contact your administrator to be added to a project.

delete.title: Delete Project
delete.label: Delete the project {{name}}
delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the project {{name}}?
delete.hint: The project and its records will be removed from users' project lists.

template.lead: A template sets up folders, permissions, the naming standard, attributes and approval workflows together.

fromFile.title: From a JSON File
fromFile.description: A template exported from another project (.json)

blank.title: Blank Project
blank.description: Only the “Proje Dosyaları” root folder; you set up the rest later.

details.codeHint: Written into the project code field of the naming standard; it must not contain the separator (-).

companies.lead: Choose the project company for each role in the template. Folder permissions and approval steps are given to these companies. Permissions of a role left empty are skipped and its steps go to the project administrators. The code is the company code in the naming standard.

dimensions.heading: Skeleton Dimensions
dimensions.hint: Each line is a folder. For example, edit the station and line lists for your project, then refresh the preview.

preview.onDemandHint: “On first file” folders appear faded in the list; they become real folders when someone uploads a file (or opens and creates the folder). This way unused empty folders do not pile up.

errors.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
